checks.detail: The browser sent the selected file through the real DM attachment input and Go API. The proxy's failure-injection endpoint was never called.

checks.detail: The tmpfs had been mounted after API startup, hiding the API-created staging/unattached directories. The first retry after raising tmpfs size therefore failed with 500. These two directories were restored inside the isolated mount before retrying again. This is not a product 507-recovery outcome.

checks.name: browser_retry_after_headroom_and_fixture_restore
checks.detail: Clicking the same visible Retry control prepared the failed file in the UI and created exactly one new row after the 507 and setup-induced 500. The Go handler's sole success branch writes HTTP 201 (backend/internal/storage/upload_direct_message_attachment/api/http_handler.go), and the local proxy forwards that status; raw response status for this browser retry was not separately captured.

checks.name: fixture_cleanup
checks.detail: Browser tab closed; local API/proxy ports idle; exact disposable PostgreSQL schema dropped and verified absent; tmpfs unmounted; its underlying synthetic file and directories removed; three locally built Go binaries and three new Windows Temp fixture files removed.
